quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The phrase between commas renames or describes the subject — that's an appositive.
quests.explanation: Subject (Maria Torres) + a longtime community organizer (appositive, renaming the subject) + was elected (verb) + to the city council (place). An appositive noun phrase gives extra identity or background about the subject.
quests.textToSpeak: Maria Torres, a longtime community organizer, was elected to the city council.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The appositive explains what kind of project the documentary was.
quests.explanation: Subject (The documentary) + a project years in the making (appositive) + finally premiered (verb) + last week (time). 'Years in the making' is an idiom describing something that took a very long time to complete.
quests.textToSpeak: The documentary, a project years in the making, finally premiered last week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The appositive tells us who is behind the initiative.
quests.explanation: Subject (The initiative) + a joint effort between three countries (appositive) + aims to restore (verb) + the wetlands (object). The appositive adds crucial context about scale and cooperation.
quests.textToSpeak: The initiative, a joint effort between three countries, aims to restore the wetlands.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'May well' is a more confident, nuanced version of 'may'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The new curriculum) + designed by teachers themselves (past participle aside) + may well improve (nuanced modal) + student engagement (object). 'May well' suggests the outcome is fairly likely, not just possible.
quests.textToSpeak: The new curriculum, designed by teachers themselves, may well improve student engagement.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The appositive highlights how unusual the exhibit is.
quests.explanation: Subject (The gallery's latest exhibit) + a bold departure from tradition (appositive) + may well divide (nuanced modal) + critics (object). 'A departure from' means a noticeable change away from what came before.
quests.textToSpeak: The gallery's latest exhibit, a bold departure from tradition, may well divide critics.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Could conceivably' is cautious but still hints at real potential.
quests.explanation: Subject (The training method) + still relatively untested (adjective aside) + could conceivably reduce (nuanced modal) + injury rates (object). 'Conceivably' means 'it's possible to imagine that', a careful, academic hedge.
quests.textToSpeak: The training method, still relatively untested, could conceivably reduce injury rates.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Might just' suggests a real, if modest, chance of happening.
quests.explanation: Subject (The proposal) + that the council rejected last year (relative clause) + might just resurface (nuanced modal) + this term (time). 'Might just' softens a prediction while still suggesting genuine possibility.
quests.textToSpeak: The proposal that the council rejected last year might just resurface this term.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The relative clause explains why the article mattered before the twist.
quests.explanation: Subject (The article) + that so many people shared (relative clause) + turned out to be (verb phrase) + entirely false (complement). 'Turn out to be' reveals a fact that becomes clear only later.
quests.textToSpeak: The article that so many people shared turned out to be entirely false.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past effort is contrasted with an uncertain future threat.
quests.explanation: Subject (The forest) + that conservationists fought to protect (relative clause) + could still face (nuanced modal) + future development (object). 'Could still' shows a risk that hasn't disappeared despite past effort.
quests.textToSpeak: The forest that conservationists fought to protect could still face future development.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A nested clause sits inside the main sentence, introduced by 'that'.
quests.explanation: Subject (Few) + would have predicted (modal + perfect) + that the smallest school in the district would win (nested clause). The nested 'that' clause contains the actual surprising outcome.
quests.textToSpeak: Few would have predicted that the smallest school in the district would win.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Once' and 'now' mark a complete reversal in opinion.
quests.explanation: Subject (Critics) + who once dismissed her work (relative clause) + now consider (verb) + it genuinely groundbreaking (object + complement). This structure is ideal for describing a dramatic shift in reputation.
quests.textToSpeak: Critics who once dismissed her work now consider it genuinely groundbreaking.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The relative clause explains exactly why recognition is now deserved.
quests.explanation: Subject (The coach) + who transformed the losing team (relative clause) + is finally receiving (verb) + recognition (object). 'Finally' suggests the recognition was overdue.
quests.textToSpeak: The coach who transformed the losing team is finally receiving recognition.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A long aside sits between the subject and the nuanced modal verb.
quests.explanation: Subject (The mural project) + which brought together artists from five neighborhoods (non-defining relative clause) + may well become (nuanced modal) + an annual tradition (complement). Longer asides require care to find the true main verb.
quests.textToSpeak: The mural project, which brought together artists from five neighborhoods, may well become an annual tradition.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Popularity is contrasted with a lack of actual proof.
quests.explanation: Subject (The claim) + though shared thousands of times (mid-sentence concession) + was never actually verified (passive verb phrase). This pattern distinguishes how widely something spread from whether it was ever confirmed true.
quests.textToSpeak: The claim, though shared thousands of times, was never actually verified.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Careful preparation is contrasted with a remaining risk.
quests.explanation: Subject (The policy) + drafted after years of consultation (past participle aside) + could still be delayed (nuanced modal, passive) + by budget cuts (agent). The risk remains despite thorough preparation.
quests.textToSpeak: The policy, drafted after years of consultation, could still be delayed by budget cuts.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Tend to' describes a general pattern, not a guarantee.
quests.explanation: Subject (Teachers) + who receive proper mentoring (relative clause) + tend to stay (verb phrase) + in the profession longer (rest). 'Tend to + verb' expresses a general tendency rather than an absolute rule.
quests.textToSpeak: Teachers who receive proper mentoring tend to stay in the profession longer.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Largely unknown' contrasts sharply with 'celebrated worldwide'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The composer) + largely unknown during her lifetime (adjective aside) + is now celebrated (verb) + worldwide (place). This highlights recognition that came only after death, a common pattern in the arts.
quests.textToSpeak: The composer, largely unknown during her lifetime, is now celebrated worldwide.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The relative clause names the risky behavior before the consequence.
quests.explanation: Subject (Athletes) + who ignore early warning signs (relative clause) + risk (verb) + far more serious injuries later (object). 'Risk + noun' means to expose oneself to a possible negative outcome.
quests.textToSpeak: Athletes who ignore early warning signs risk far more serious injuries later.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The aside shows speed and scale before the consequence.
quests.explanation: Subject (The petition) + which gathered thousands of signatures within days (non-defining relative clause) + forced (verb) + the council to respond (object + infinitive). 'Force someone to do something' shows an unavoidable result.
quests.textToSpeak: The petition, which gathered thousands of signatures within days, forced the council to respond.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The past participle aside explains why the change was needed.
quests.explanation: Subject (The platform) + criticized for spreading misinformation (past participle aside) + introduced (verb) + stricter fact-checking measures (object). The aside gives the reason behind the platform's new policy.
quests.textToSpeak: The platform, criticized for spreading misinformation, introduced stricter fact-checking measures.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Tentative' means cautious or not yet fully confirmed.
quests.explanation: Subject (The reef) + monitored closely by marine biologists (past participle aside) + shows (verb) + tentative signs of recovery (object). 'Tentative' signals cautious optimism rather than certainty.
quests.textToSpeak: The reef, monitored closely by marine biologists, shows tentative signs of recovery.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Flourish' means to grow and develop very successfully.
quests.explanation: Subject (Students) + who struggled under the old system (relative clause) + may well flourish (nuanced modal) + under this one (rest). 'Flourish' is a strong, positive verb often used for growth or success.
quests.textToSpeak: Students who struggled under the old system may well flourish under this one.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Once' and 'now' again frame a striking change in scale.
quests.explanation: Subject (The festival) + once a small local gathering (noun phrase aside) + now draws (verb) + visitors from across the country (object). This 'once...now' pattern reliably shows growth over time.
quests.textToSpeak: The festival, once a small local gathering, now draws visitors from across the country.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A cautious modal expresses a dramatic, uncertain future possibility.
quests.explanation: Subject (The rule change) + controversial among veteran players (adjective aside) + could conceivably reshape (nuanced modal) + the entire sport (object). Pairing a big claim with a cautious modal keeps the sentence balanced.
quests.textToSpeak: The rule change, controversial among veteran players, could conceivably reshape the entire sport.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Has never turned away' is present perfect, spanning all of its history.
quests.explanation: Subject (The shelter) + run entirely by volunteers (past participle aside) + has never turned away (present perfect) + a family in need (object). Present perfect here covers the shelter's entire history up to now.
quests.textToSpeak: The shelter, run entirely by volunteers, has never turned away a family in need.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The relative clause reveals a hidden step before the public reaction.
quests.explanation: Subject (The interview) + which was heavily edited before broadcast (non-defining relative clause, passive) + sparked (verb) + immediate backlash (object). 'Spark backlash' means to trigger a strong negative public reaction.
quests.textToSpeak: The interview, which was heavily edited before broadcast, sparked immediate backlash.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Old context explains why the modern decision matters.
quests.explanation: Subject (The dam) + built decades ago without proper review (past participle aside) + may finally be decommissioned (nuanced modal, passive). 'Decommission' means to formally take something out of service.
quests.textToSpeak: The dam, built decades ago without proper review, may finally be decommissioned.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'In memory of' introduces the emotional origin of the fund.
quests.explanation: Subject (The scholarship fund) + established in memory of a beloved teacher (past participle aside) + now supports (verb) + dozens yearly (object). 'In memory of' shows the fund honors someone who has passed away.
quests.textToSpeak: The scholarship fund, established in memory of a beloved teacher, now supports dozens yearly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Famously private' explains the behavior described in the main clause.
quests.explanation: Subject (The novelist) + famously private about her personal life (adjective aside) + rarely gives (verb) + interviews (object). 'Famously' means widely known for a particular trait, here her privacy.
quests.textToSpeak: The novelist, famously private about her personal life, rarely gives interviews.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The aside explains the clinic's specialty before the unusual detail.
quests.explanation: Subject (The clinic) + dedicated specifically to athletes (past participle aside) + treats (verb) + injuries most doctors rarely see (object + embedded clause). The embedded clause adds a nested layer of detail.
quests.textToSpeak: The clinic, dedicated specifically to athletes, treats injuries most doctors rarely see.
